omar_security: grabbing files. quick Q: do they require BYOK for the POC or just for prod? that changes setup.

devops-bot: Ticket created: RWI-4988  security-intake. Assigned to omar_security.
liam_engineer: engineering note: supported BYOK for demo = AWS KMS or Azure KV only. non-supported vendors will add platform time. ops estimate for BYOK demo: 1 engineer-day + 6 GPU-hours.
omar_security: checklist i'll attach to RWI-4988: KMS ARN + key policy, SOC2 PDF, redacted pen test, data classification (PII?), network diagram. I'll ask customer for ARNs and rotation policy with 48h deadline.
nina_sales: pinged customer for ARNs and rotation policy. will post reply here.
